copy.facebook:
I know exactly what the next seven days look like for most of you: too much coffee, too many browser tabs, and that familiar, sinking feeling when you realize how much is still left to write. 

It’s easy to fall into the '2:2 Trap'—procrastinating until Monday morning and then scrambling to get something, anything, onto the page. But if you want to aim higher, you need to swap the chaos for a bit of structure. Here is how we’re handling next week:

• Audit: List every remaining assignment and its weight.
• Prioritize: Tackle the high-value tasks first while your brain is fresh.
• Segment: Don’t 'write an essay.' Write an intro, then a methodology, then two paragraphs. 
• Protect: Block out two hours of deep work where your phone stays in another room.

If the workload is looking impossible, don't just stress in silence. Shoot me a message on WhatsApp at +91 95098 93638 and let’s map it out together. You’ve got this.
